problem_context.problem_statement: 修正 canonical CircularAreaLogicalState 的 b_status 语义，并重新验证真实 Init/API 调用点 harness。不得改任何可执行 C token，只允许 annotation 与 shared case_lib：b_status 是 readidx==writeidx 时区分空/满的标志，不是所有中间状态的满标志；修正 Read/Write 声明为 EOK=0、ERROR=1。完成 canonical symexec、全部 manual VC、fixed goal_check、final-check 与 freshness。
problem_context.expected_behavior: Init 成功返回 mixed_full canonical backing；空端点 status=0，满端点 status=1，中间逻辑长度允许 status 0/1；所有 harness 调用依次保持或更新同一 backing resource；Read/Write 生产成功码为0、错误码为1。
problem_context.input_output_contract: 证明 Init→metadata→Release、Init→empty Read→Release、Init→Write→Release、Init→Write→Read→Release、重复 Write、Read 后 Write、Reset 等调用序列的前后置可组合；调用者外部数组资源按被调用 API 的真实规格提供。
spec_hint: CircularAreaLogicalState 保留 index/range/length/writeidx/live-bytes；加入 b_status in {0,1}，只在 length=0/capacity 端点约束 status。不要引入 undef_full→full。修正 Read empty ERROR=1/live success EOK=0，Write success EOK=0。
preferred_hidden_properties: writeidx=(readidx+logical length) mod capacity；readidx=writeidx 只可能 logical length 0 或 capacity，并由 status 区分。
forbidden_patterns: 不得修改 harness 函数体、宏、API 签名或任何可执行 token；不得假设 undef_full 可以升级为 full；不得读取 QCP_demos_human；不得使用 forbidden lemma。

annotation_contract.ready_condition: agent_result.annotation.status == completed and ready_for_annotation_check_round == true only after canonical QCP, case_lib coqc, and annotation-checking pass; self_reworkable_failures must be empty
annotation_contract.blocked_condition: only phase skill hard blockers should use status == blocked; self_repair_budget_exhausted is work evidence, not an automatic blocked condition

Loop invariants must connect processed state to the final mathematical postcondition.
avoid_spec_antipatterns: Do not weaken the spec to shape-only or bounds-only conditions.
Do not restate the C loops as the mathematical definition.
